title: Chat/status log with Terraria colours ('X has awoken!' in purple) replacing the big banners
player_outcome:
World messages scroll up a chat log at the bottom-left in Terraria's colours and fade after 10 seconds:
- 'Eye of Cthulhu has awoken!' and 'has been defeated!' in purple.
- 'The Guide has arrived!' in blue.
- 'was slain...' in red.
- 'The Blood Moon is rising...' in green.

Enter shows the last 50 messages.
design:
New game/UI/Hud/ChatLog.cs: a VBox in the Chat rect (bottom-left; moves right of the crafting column while the inventory is open) with 10 pooled autowrapping Labels (16 px, outline 4), newest at the bottom.
- `Add(string text, Color color)`: each line lives 10 s, then fades over 1 s.
- History mode on a new `chat` action (key Enter): shows the last 50 lines on a translucent backdrop as an Overlay gate, with no text input, until Enter or Esc.

Route messages in Hud.cs, replacing Announce and Toast:
- npcs.BossSpawned 'has awoken!', BossDefeated 'has been defeated!', BossLeft 'has left!': UiTheme.BossPurple.
- Town.Arrived 'has arrived!' and Departed 'has left!': NpcArrived blue.
- Town.Died 'was slain...': NpcSlain red.
- Events.Announced, Progression.Raised and npcs.Announced: EventGreen.
- Objectives.Announced: its data colour.
- ItemUse.Caught 'Caught X!': rarity colour.
- Keep `Announce(text, color)` as a forwarding API.
Delete the 30 px centred banner stack (Hud.cs:88-92,282-294). Add an optional setting BigAnnouncements, default off, that shows only the boss-awoken banner at 24 px.
input.json: add "chat": ["key:Enter"]. Add it to KeyBindings.Listed.
files_modify: game/Debug/UiCommands.cs, game/Debug/UiProbes.cs — chat command and probe
files_add: game/UI/Hud/ChatLog.cs — pooled fading log with history mode
verification: Lavapipe screenshot after summoning a boss: purple chat line at the bottom-left, no banner
risks: The Enter key may conflict with the console LineEdit submit; the console is Modal and consumes it first.
